name: Lyndal Stephens Greth & family

controls.name: Diamondback Energy, Inc.
controls.role: Largest shareholder; ultimate beneficial owner of shares held by SGF FANG Holdings, LP (shared voting/dispositive power). Received stock when Diamondback bought the family's Endeavor Energy Resources (~$26B, closed Sept 2024). Endeavor stockholders nominate four Diamondback directors under a Stockholders Agreement.

vehicles.name: SGF FANG Holdings, LP
vehicles.notes: Delaware LP; record holder of the family's Diamondback shares since an Aug 13, 2025 internal reorganization (replacing Autry Stephens Management Trust, ACS Capital Management LLC and Stephens family trusts); Greth is ultimate beneficial owner

Repurchase agreement: Diamondback bought 2,000,000 shares from SGF FANG at $152.59; SGF FANG got the right to sell up to 3,000,000 shares per quarter to Diamondback at prevailing closing prices through Dec 31, 2026
